cover.headline_html:
Not a store.
Not a blog.
A world I built.
cover.sub: Six rooms, one address. Here's what's actually inside parispullen.com.

sections.headline: My home, room by room.
sections.sub: Nine floors of it, real artifacts you can open, a screening room that's actually playing something. Walk it like you're actually here.

sections.headline: Every object in the house opens.
sections.sub: Twelve navy suits. Two tuxedos. Six ties, hung, never rolled. Click anything and it tells you the real story behind it.

sections.headline: Pan the room. Walk the floors.
sections.sub: Arrows move you room to room, floor to floor — or jump straight to any of the nine from the Floors panel.

sections.headline: A gentleman's guide to Charlotte.
sections.sub: 75 verified spots across seven districts — every address and access rule checked before it went on the page.

sections.headline: My actual takes, not press releases.
sections.sub: Tech, film, style, watches, whatever else — whatever caught my attention that week, written like I'd tell you in person.

sections.headline: 560 pieces, made to order.
sections.sub: A lookbook, not a store. Filter it, save what you like, send us the names.

sections.headline: You don't buy it. You get invited to it.
sections.sub: A hundred percent oil, mixed by hand, one hundred bottles total. The first one's under glass.

sections.headline: Everything here was assembled on purpose.
sections.sub: Justin Anthony Paris Pullen. Born Dayton, Ohio. Based Charlotte, North Carolina. Call sign 00.

closing.headline: Open parispullen.com
closing.sub: Tap Menu in the top right and pick a room — every one of them is one click away.
